summary: Braskem S.A. filed a Form 6-K with a consolidated summary voting report for an Extraordinary General Meeting originally called for May 28, 2026 and postponed to June 8, 2026. The meeting agenda involves amendments to the company's bylaws to incorporate provisions of a new Shareholders Agreement and governance changes. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private, restructuring, or other special-situation transaction is disclosed. This is a routine corporate governance filing by a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a proxy voting update. The filing does not trigger any special-situations category.
